desc: Live test of the decoded post-upload interface power request. BLOCKED on the same rollback enrollment as 215/228 (evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-rig-blocked-enrolled-object-has-no-proxy.md). ROOT CAUSE (evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-trackpad-post-upload-reset-contract.md): comm command 0x40 is the MTP coprocessor's interface POWER request, not a reset. We sent the 4-byte v1 form {0x40,1,iface,state}; J614s MTP firmware (AppleMTPFirmwareMac-5340.61.4~438, SDK 25F63) implements ONLY the 9-byte v2 form {0x40,0x02,iface,state,phase,u32 status} sent twice (phase 0 will-change, phase 1 has-changed, status 0). Byte 1 is a VERSION, proven by the firmware string 'Unsupported power state version %hhu!'. The firmware handler checks 'cmp w1, 9' on payload length FIRST, so our 4-byte form returns 0xE00002C2 (kIOReturnBadArgument) before any other field is read -- an exact match to the observed failure. There is therefore no missing enable command: the enable IS the power-on that never happened, which is also why no touch reports stream (hid-magicmouse deliberately skips the MT enable for BUS_HOST devices). ARTIFACT: patches/t6040-dockchannel-hid-reset-contract.patch applied after t6040-dockchannel-trackpad-fw.patch via TRACKPAD_RESET_CONTRACT=1 (kbuild gates it on TRACKPAD_FW=1). Image-trackpad-reset-contract sha256 80c15f58809d7815fb82487bdc5a3f065409baab61bc4fa1fe263cfcc87852c4, System.map 30115accb2872d864b7945c76a3f04107ce4201bb8fe706b06137ddc7b8bd36f, config a74daa271dd59cbcd8aae83b33a3e0c84a9ac69e5425bae72e3f3e863269c54f. Renamed from the colliding Image-macsmc-hid-type-fix-trackpad-cpufreq name deliberately. New-code presence proven in the binary: the string 'v2 power request rejected' occurs once, and zero times in the pre-patch control Image. REPRODUCIBILITY SATISFIED: two clean builds from independent trees (/build/linux-trackpad-reset and -b2) produced byte-identical Image 80c15f58 and System.map 30115acc. SCOPE/SAFETY: this is a live HIDF upload attempt and is covered by CJ's existing ticket-126 volatile-upload exception for blob a1f4131d ONLY -- volatile DMA, no flash, no persistent write, and the machine is known not to crash on it (ticket 197 refuted that). No SMC/SPMI/PMU/charger/NVRAM/firmware write. Storage-disabled RAM root. PROCEDURE: chainload at maxcpus=1; open the multi-touch input device to trigger dchid_start_interface; observe whether command 0x40 now succeeds where it previously returned 0xe00002c2; then run 't6040-input-report watch /dev/input/event0 60'. PASS = 0x40 accepted AND a nonzero event count while a finger is on the trackpad. NOTE motion needs a human finger, so the final confirmation is CJ's; the reporter exists so a touch during an unattended boot still produces hard evidence (byte counts plus a hex dump of the first reports). FALSIFIERS from the evidence: if v2 returns 0xe00002ca instead of 0 the encoding is right and the remaining problem is DMA reachability; if 0x40 succeeds but no reports arrive, the gap is above the transport (AppleMultitouchDriver was not decoded). STOP on SError, DART fault, firmware panic, unexpected reset, or console loss. RECOVERY: sanctioned warm reboot; RAM root leaves nothing persistent.
